assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 蓝线、绿线与河湖管理范围等法定控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (river blue line, green line) are unknown; this proposal makes no numeric conclusions about them.

assumptions.statement_zh: 水文、流量与滨水实测数据仅作概念引用，不替代官方监测；滨水设施与护岸关系以概念示意表达。
assumptions.statement_en: Hydrological data are referenced conceptually only; riverside works are shown as concept diagrams, not engineering.

assumptions.statement_zh: 路演广场、AI科普驿站与社区共验场等设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 路演人流与体验数据仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Crowd experience data uses anonymous aggregation with human review; no irreversible automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 路演季、科普周与夜集等活动体系均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The roadshow and science-week event system is a design suggestion, not a confirmed government arrangement.
